question: The Uniform Civil Code primarily seeks to replace which types of laws currently governing personal matters in India?

options.text: Religious personal laws (e.g., Hindu Marriage Act, Muslim Personal Law)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Religious personal laws (e.g., Hindu Marriage Act, Muslim Personal Law)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Uniform Civil Code (UCC) is a proposal to replace personal laws based on religious scriptures and customs with a common set governing every citizen.
 
• Personal laws in India differ for various religious communities, covering marriage, divorce, inheritance, adoption, and maintenance.
 
• The UCC aims to ensure equality and secular
